glosses: scheme (a systematic plan of future action; also, a group of independent but interrelated elements comprising a unified whole)

examples.text: Se requiere urgentemente que ellos actualicen sus sistemas.
examples.en: There is an urgent need for them to update their system.

examples.text: Todos los sistemas de soporte vital han sido gravemente dañados.
examples.en: All life support systems have been severely damaged.
